name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Technical Delivery & Project Lead | Requirements, Prioritization & Cross-Team Delivery in SaaS
summary: SaaS delivery and implementation lead with 15+ years translating business needs into technical requirements, sequencing the work, and getting it delivered across teams. I built sequenced implementation plans at Accelo, led a team of 20 (later 8) delivering 25+ launches a month at Wix, and today build production integrations and automation myself, so I can talk tradeoffs with engineers and explain them to leadership in plain language. Working SQL, Jira, and Power BI; Denver-based.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Translate non-technical stakeholders' goals into precise technical requirements and acceptance standards, then build, test, and deploy the resulting automation and AI workflows.
Own the build backlog across concurrent client engagements, prioritizing new work, fixes, and improvements, and documenting every requirement and deliverable.
Build integrations with webhooks, APIs, batch data imports, and custom JavaScript/Python code steps; monitor output with evaluation loops to catch failures early.
Write SQL on BigQuery data and build Power BI dashboards to support prioritization and report progress.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Collaborated with Product and Engineering, turning partner feedback into structured, prioritized input for the roadmap.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Rebuilt internal processes that improved reporting accuracy, reduced handoff errors, and strengthened cross-team alignment, managing work in ClickUp.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Led a team of 20 (later 8) onboarding specialists delivering 25+ launches per month at 110% of implementation targets, overseeing scope, priorities, and delivery.
Defined the CRM fields and data standards required for sales and onboarding workflows on a new vertical that went from proof of concept to profitable.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, and handed them to implementation teams to execute.
Guided workflow design and API integrations with implementation teams, escalating risks to leadership early.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
